edges.reason: propose is gated by require(dCult.checkHighestStaker(0,msg.sender)) and uses msg.sender as proposer and latestProposalIds key.
castVoteInternal requires !dCult.checkHighestStaker(0,msg.sender), checking msg.sender instead of the voter parameter so signature-based votes bypass the restriction.
cancel requires msg.sender == proposal.proposer.
_setVotingDelay requires msg.sender == admin.
_setInvesteeDetails requires msg.sender == admin.
_fundInvestee requires msg.sender == treasury.
_setVotingPeriod requires msg.sender == admin.
_setProposalThreshold requires msg.sender == admin.
_setWhitelistAccountExpiration requires msg.sender == admin or whitelistGuardian.
_setWhitelistGuardian requires msg.sender == admin.
_initiate requires msg.sender == admin.
_setPendingAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin and non-zero.
_AcceptTimelockAdmin performs an admin-sensitive timelock call with no msg.sender check at all.
_authorizeUpgrade requires admin == msg.sender.
propose writes the new Proposal struct into proposals[proposalCount].
propose increments proposalCount.
propose stores latestProposalIds[proposer] = newProposal.id.
propose computes startBlock and endBlock through add256.
propose calls state() to reject existing active or pending proposals.
propose makes a state-changing external call dCult.checkHighestStaker(0,msg.sender) before creating the proposal.
queue derives eta as add256(block.timestamp, timelock.delay()), making execution timing timestamp dependent.
queue loops over proposal.targets calling queueOrRevertInternal.
queue reads the proposal actions and writes proposal.eta.
queue requires state(proposalId) == Succeeded.
queueOrRevertInternal forwards each action to timelock.queueTransaction.
execute performs an external value-bearing call timelock.executeTransaction{value: proposal.values[i]} inside a loop, handing control to attacker-selected targets.
execute sets proposal.executed = true and reads proposal actions and eta.
execute requires state(proposalId) == Queued.
cancel loops calling timelock.cancelTransaction for each proposal action.
cancel reads the proposal actions and sets proposal.canceled = true.
state compares block.timestamp with eta + GRACE_PERIOD to decide Expired.
state loads the Proposal struct fields to derive the current state.
state uses add256(proposal.eta, timelock.GRACE_PERIOD()) for the expiry boundary.
state queries timelock.GRACE_PERIOD().
castVote delegates the ballot to castVoteInternal.
castVoteWithReason delegates the ballot to castVoteInternal.
castVoteBySig delegates the ballot of the recovered signatory to castVoteInternal.
castVoteBySig recovers the signatory address with ecrecover.
castVoteBySig builds the EIP-712 domain separator using getChainIdInternal.
castVoteInternal makes a state-changing external call dCult.checkHighestStaker(0,msg.sender) as the vote gate.
castVoteInternal reads voting power via dCult.getPastVotes(voter, proposal.startBlock).
castVoteInternal updates proposal tallies and the voter Receipt.
castVoteInternal accumulates for/against/abstain tallies using add256.
castVoteInternal requires state(proposalId) == Active.
isWhitelisted compares whitelistAccountExpirations[account] against block.timestamp.
isWhitelisted reads whitelistAccountExpirations.
_setVotingDelay writes votingDelay.
_setInvesteeDetails writes investeeDetails[nextInvestee].
_setInvesteeDetails increments nextInvestee.
_setInvesteeDetails bumps nextInvestee using add256.
_setInvesteeDetails derives the emitted index with sub256(nextInvestee,1).
_fundInvestee writes nextInvesteeFund.
_fundInvestee increments nextInvesteeFund using add256.
_fundInvestee computes sub256(nextInvesteeFund,1) for the returned/emitted investee id.
_fundInvestee reads investeeDetails for the funded investee.
_setVotingPeriod writes votingPeriod.
_setProposalThreshold writes proposalThreshold.
_setWhitelistAccountExpiration writes whitelistAccountExpirations.
_setWhitelistGuardian writes whitelistGuardian.
_initiate calls timelock.acceptAdmin(), transferring timelock admin rights to this governor.
_initiate overwrites proposalCount from GovernorAlpha(governorAlpha).proposalCount().
_initiate sets initialProposalId = proposalCount.
_setPendingAdmin writes pendingAdmin.
_acceptAdmin moves pendingAdmin into admin.
_acceptAdmin clears pendingAdmin to address(0).
_AcceptTimelockAdmin calls timelock.acceptAdmin() and any external caller can trigger it.
_authorizeUpgrade compares admin with msg.sender before allowing an implementation upgrade.
add256 performs a raw a + b addition whose result is validated with require(c >= a).
sub256 performs a raw a - b subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
getChainIdInternal reads the chain id through inline assembly.
initialize assigns the timelock interface.
initialize assigns the dCult token interface.
initialize sets votingDelay.
initialize sets votingPeriod.
initialize sets proposalThreshold.
initialize sets admin to timelock_.
initialize sets the treasury address.
targets array flows into the stored proposal actions.
values array flows into the stored proposal actions.
signatures array flows into the stored proposal actions.
calldatas array flows into the stored proposal actions.
description is only emitted in ProposalCreated.
proposalId selects the proposal checked by state().
support selects which tally branch castVoteInternal updates.
voter keys getPastVotes and the receipt storage write.
account indexes whitelistAccountExpirations in isWhitelisted.
local eta is stored into proposal.eta by queue.
local votes from getPastVotes is added to a tally and stored in the receipt.
local latestProposalId is read to detect an existing live proposal.
newVotingDelay argument is validated and written to votingDelay.
newVotingPeriod argument is validated and written to votingPeriod.
newProposalThreshold argument is validated and written to proposalThreshold.
expiration argument is written to whitelistAccountExpirations.
newPendingAdmin argument is written to pendingAdmin.
_investee argument is written to investeeDetails[nextInvestee].
locally computed startBlock/endBlock values are persisted by propose.

normalization_plan.reason: targets is only consumed by propose, which stores it into the proposal actions.
values is only consumed by propose and later forwarded as msg.value in execute.
signatures is only consumed by propose to build the stored proposal actions.
calldatas is only consumed by propose to build the stored proposal actions.
description is only used to emit ProposalCreated from propose.
proposalId is the lookup key used by state() to derive the proposal lifecycle state.
support only selects the for/against/abstain tally branch inside castVoteInternal.
voter is only used by castVoteInternal for getPastVotes and the receipt write.
account is only used to index whitelistAccountExpirations in isWhitelisted.
eta is a queue-local value that immediately becomes proposal.eta.
votes is a castVoteInternal-local result of getPastVotes added to the tallies.
latestProposalId is a propose-local read of latestProposalIds[msg.sender].
newVotingDelay is only validated and written to votingDelay by _setVotingDelay.
newVotingPeriod is only validated and written to votingPeriod by _setVotingPeriod.
newProposalThreshold is only validated and written to proposalThreshold by _setProposalThreshold.
expiration is only written into whitelistAccountExpirations by that setter.
newPendingAdmin is only written into pendingAdmin by _setPendingAdmin.
_investee is only written into investeeDetails by _setInvesteeDetails.
startBlock/endBlock are propose-local results of add256 stored on the new proposal.
